title: Kreisleriana - No. 1
notable_excerpt: Key: D minor. Chord journey: i - v5 - i#7 - #iii - #iv - V - i#7 - #iii - i - i - bVI7 - iv7 - bII6 - bvi - vii#6 - bII6 - i, outbursts over a dark chromatic bass. Texture: fast chordal outbursts alternating with dense sixteenth-note inner motion.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #51540 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel (Werke Serie VII)), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~98%, pitch ~92% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op16_kreisleriana_1.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Kreisleriana Op. 16.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
